This is a production clean plate: the finished resting scene will include authored lights, screen content and water highlights and must remain attractive during long periods of stillness.
Constraints: no camera movement, motion blur, scanlines, warped surfaces, bloom, UI, captions or watermark. No text except explicitly requested scene branding.
Scene/backdrop: A fresh composition of a quiet Japanese village street, traditional houses, distant mountain silhouette, a rural railway in the middle distance, and one red vending machine. A small open drainage stream runs through the middle-lower portion, clearly visible inside the central crop rather than at the extreme edge. Summer greenery. Keep the street and mountains readable with simple shapes; railway geometry must be horizontal and unobstructed. Vending-machine glass has a dark, plain screen; stream has a dark base with subtle static material facets and fixed banks, no painted white highlights. No train in the background master. Reserve a modest open patch of sky.
Lighting: legible daytime with stepped material shading and restrained fixed light spill; future night variant shares exact geometry.
Output only the static background clean plate. The finished presentation will assemble authored resting states over the reserved surfaces.

Asset type: static production clean plate for a full-screen pixel-art chat wallpaper with very rare subtle events.
Style: richly composed pixel-art game background with deliberate, consistently scaled pixel clusters, stepped material shading and crisp silhouettes. Intended production grid: 256 by 448 pixels; this is an art-direction target, not a claim that the generator will enforce an exact raster grid. Preserve cozy environmental richness through layered architecture, vegetation, furnishings and selective material detail. Use coherent color ramps, warm inhabited interiors and atmospheric depth. Avoid isolated pixel noise, photographic textures, soft antialiasing and digitally painted micro-detail. Portrait composition, fixed camera; one image only, no diptych or sprite sheet.
Composition: full scenic portrait, important objects inside the central 72% of the width and away from header/composer occlusion. Preserve visual interest throughout the scene. Reserve only a few localized regions for rare pixel events; no dense streaks, widespread sparkles, dramatic splashes or exaggerated motion cues.
Animation surfaces: give water a restrained static base with subtle material facets and fixed boundaries; omit only the moving glints/reflection fragments to be authored later. Fully design lamp housings, tube shapes and screen borders. Preserve restrained fixed illumination on surrounding surfaces. This is a production clean plate: the finished resting scene will include authored lights, screen content and water highlights and must remain attractive during long periods of stillness.
Constraints: no camera movement, motion blur, scanlines, warped surfaces, bloom, UI, captions or watermark. No text except explicitly requested scene branding.
Scene/backdrop: A fresh cozy retro-computer room overlooking a city through a large window. One beige CRT and keyboard, a desk lamp, cassette deck and small plant. Place the CRT screen and a strip of visible sky area within the central safe crop. Render the CRT glass as an empty dark green-black rectangle with a clean pixel border, no globe, no text, no static scanlines. Desk-lamp housing is a fixed shape; all objects and city architecture have crisp readable silhouettes and selective rich detail. Sky has no baked stars; these will be placed as authored sprites. Make the CRT large enough for several miniature terminal rows and a distinct block cursor to be authored into the resting screen. Preserve the lived-in desk details and warm fixed room lighting.
Lighting: legible daytime with stepped material shading and restrained fixed light spill; future night variant shares exact geometry.
Output only the static background clean plate. The finished presentation will assemble authored resting states over the reserved surfaces.

versions.label: Study 01
versions.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: paired full-scenic pixel-art chat wallpaper study. Output a single landscape 1536x1024 image consisting of TWO EQUAL portrait panels, exactly flush at x=50%, no gutter, divider, border, lettering or labels. LEFT is daytime, RIGHT is nighttime of the EXACT SAME scene, identical camera, geometry, buildings, objects and composition. Each half is a complete independent portrait view. Style: exquisite coherent finely detailed 16-bit pixel art, visible crisp square pixel clusters, restrained dithering, limited tasteful palette, no smooth painting, no blur, no vector art, no UI, no watermark. Fixed camera, tranquil lived-in mood, no people. Full scenery reaches every edge. Keep focal details away from extreme side edges and give the center breathing room for chat text. Night changes actual illumination, moonlight, lit windows and lamps, not merely a dark overlay. Scene: cozy late-1980s computer hobbyist room overlooking a retro-futuristic city through a very large central window. Beige CRT computer and keyboard on a wooden desk low in the foreground, cassette deck, stacked floppy disks, houseplant, desk lamp. CRT displays abstract green pixel marks, no readable words. City outside has rooftop antennas, a distant elevated rail line and layered towers. Left: soft daytime sunlight across the desk, pale blue sky. Right: moonlight, tiny city window lights, amber desk lamp and green CRT glow. Calm composition, broad window/sky area across upper center, no people.
